what_this_is: The index of MIW present-day canonical answers. These are NOT past-paper questions: no entry here has a sitting, a printed serial or printed marks, and no entry here is evidence that any examiner ever set this wording.

entries.title: Preserving the Main Propulsion Diesel Engine for a Three-Month Commercial Lay-Up
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review if (a) an IACS member materially changes its laid-up condition or reactivation survey requirements, (b) SOLAS chapter I regulation 11 is amended, or (c) MIW solves a past paper that sets this preservation task directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twelve months.

entries.title: Lloyd's Open Form
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review if Lloyd's publishes an edition after LOF 2020, if the SCOPIC revision in current use is established (the record currently declares that MIW has not established it), or if the Salvage Convention 1989 is amended. Routine re-review at twelve months.

entries.title: Treaty, Convention and Protocol
entries.next_review_trigger: Content-stable by nature - the examples are completed treaty events. Re-review if MIW solves a past paper that sets this taxonomy directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated. Routine re-review at twenty-four months rather than twelve, and the reason is recorded here rather than left to look like an oversight.

entries.title: Surface Cracks on the Tail-End Shaft Keyway
entries.limb_label: B. Surface cracks on the keyway of the tail-end shaft
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review if (a) IACS materially revises UR Z21 or a member society changes its screwshaft survey or crack-detection requirements, (b) SOLAS chapter I regulation 11 is amended, or (c) MIW solves a past paper that sets the tail-end shaft or its keyway directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twenty-four months rather than twelve: the mechanism is engineering and does not move, and the class detail moves slowly.

entries.title: Why a Ship Needs Marine Insurance, and How Hull and Cargo Claims Are Made
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review if (a) the Marine Insurance Act 1963 is amended or replaced - it is the one instrument behind this entry that has not been recently reformed and is therefore the one most likely to move next; (b) the Schedule to the Carriage of Goods by Sea Act 2025 or the Bills of Lading Act 2025 is amended; (c) a limitation amount under any of the cited liability conventions is raised, which would matter only if a convention figure were ever added to this answer; or (d) MIW solves a past paper that sets the documents-and-validity task directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twenty-four months: the Indian statute book was rebuilt in 2025 and is unlikely to move again soon, and the market wordings move slowly.

entries.title: Coping with Stress-Affected Personnel, and Implementing It for Better Teamwork
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review when the comprehensive review of the STCW Convention and Code reaches adoption, since its fatigue and hours-of-work workstream bears directly on this answer; or if the ILO adopts further amendments to the MLC Code affecting health protection, medical care, accommodation or connectivity; or if IMO supersedes MSC.1/Circ.1598. Also re-review if MIW solves a past paper that sets coping with stress-affected personnel directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twelve months, because two of the three instruments behind it are actively moving.

entries.title: What the Manila Amendments Changed for the Engine Department
entries.limb_label: A. The major changes and amendments made by the Manila amendments for the engine department
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review when the comprehensive review of the STCW Convention and Code reaches its adoption meeting, since that is the event that will change this answer materially and is the reason the entry carries a not_yet_in_force item at all. Also re-review if the fuel-specific interim training guidelines are converted into mandatory amendments, or if MIW solves a past paper that sets the Manila engine-department changes directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twelve months, because the comprehensive review is actively moving.

entries.title: Onboard Training and the Standard of Competence under STCW Chapter III, and the Chief Engineer's Role
entries.limb_label: B. Onboard training and the standard of competence under STCW chapter III, the Chief Engineer's role, and the criteria for evaluating competence
entries.next_review_trigger: Re-review when the comprehensive review of the STCW Convention and Code reaches its adoption meeting, since training and assessment methods are within its scope and it is the single event most likely to change this answer. Also re-review if MIW acquires the STCW Code text under licence, which would allow the competence-table illustrations to be replaced by properly cited content and would remove the largest declared limitation on this entry; or if MIW solves a past paper that sets onboard training and the criteria for evaluating competence directly, in which case the relationship between that sitting-anchored answer and this one must be adjudicated rather than assumed. Routine re-review at twelve months, in step with its sibling CA-EM-0007.
